axisConvention: authoring = Blender V8 units, +X bow, +Y port, +Z up; game = (-y, z, x) * metresPerUnit (game +Z bow, +X starboard, +Y up)
notes: metresPerUnit 0.5 decided 2026-09-24 (uniform; see docs/MODULAR-SHIPS.md for the derivation). maxMiddles 3 = the bay counts Astra verified closed in Blender (0-3). berthSpaceUnits 0.5 (2026-09-25, docs/SHIPYARD-SECTIONS-UI.md step 2): one berth's cost in a section's interior space budget (hold-cell units) -- a bunk + its share of access, PROVISIONAL.

joinProfiles.description: Hull cross-section interface of the V2 and V3 modular hull families (deck beam 9.28).
V1 hull cross-section. Same section names and lengths as W1-r2 but a DIFFERENT shape; never joins W1-r2.
Reserved for a future broader hull family. Not authored; exists so a placeholder module can name it and be rejected against W1-r2.

Hull cross-section interface of the W1-center-expansion-r1 family (deck beam 12.08, +2.8 over W1-r2's 9.28; a centre-widened W1-r2, not an independently modelled cross-section). Length and depth UNCHANGED from W1-r2 (same keelZU/deckZU) -- this supersedes the W2-placeholder/W2-r1 direction as the width upgrade (Astra, 2026-09-25); never joins W1-r2 directly.
joinProfiles.sourceNote: art-staging/modular-width-inserts-v1/manifest.json (added_beam_units 2.8, standard_beam_units 9.28, expanded_beam_units 12.08) + hydrostatics/*.json (deck-level sectional area identical, bit-for-bit, at all 4 touching faces -- stern fwd, middle aft, middle fwd, bow aft -- verified by ExpandedHullValidation). profilePoints NOT independently measured (no interfaces.json loop data shipped with this kit, unlike the W2-r1 kit); left 0, informational only, not read by any code path (ModuleLibrary/ShipAssembler never look at it).

joinProfiles.description: Hull cross-section interface of the raised-deck family (continuous flush upper deck at Z 4.20 over the W1x lower hull, between-deck 2.44 u = 1.22 m). deckZU stays the flotation/depth datum (1.76, same as W1x -- underwater form unchanged, sDepth == 1); upperDeckZU is the NEW flush-deck datum. Never joins W1x/W1-r2 directly (no partial raised ends).
